versions.label: SudoDeck v2.1.3
versions.notes: Display sleep + new PNG logo on boot splash

versions.label: SudoDeck v2.1.2
versions.notes: Removed button icon support (to revisit later). Switched to no_ota partition scheme (69% flash).

versions.label: SudoDeck v2.1.1
versions.notes: Fixed icon/screensaver color rendering (byte-swap data for SPI display). Icons now persist after button press — redrawn after flash effect.

versions.label: SudoDeck v2.1.0
versions.notes: App Launcher uses OS search (Win key / Cmd+Space / Super) instead of run dialog — type 'Calculator' not 'calc.exe'. App icons: upload 32x32 images to buttons via web tool, displayed on CYD grid. Faster app launch: ~250ms total.

versions.label: SudoDeck v2.0.3
versions.notes: App Launcher action: select OS (Windows/macOS/Linux), type app name, press button — device opens run dialog, types name, hits Enter. Macro step editor: combo steps show mod+key, delay shows ms.

versions.label: SudoDeck v2.0.2
versions.notes: Stability: serial buffer OOM protection, removed periodic header redraw (flicker fix), non-blocking touch debounce. WiFi: clearer header status messages.

versions.label: SudoDeck v2.0.1
versions.notes: WiFi fixes: human-readable error messages, auto-connect after set_wifi, 30s timeout, SSID shown while connecting. BLE: health check ensures continuous advertising for Windows auto-connect.

versions.label: SudoDeck v2.0.0
versions.notes: WiFi + widget screensavers (F1 standings + football scores), WiFi status in header, no_ota partition (68% flash)

versions.label: SudoDeck v1.0.0
versions.notes: Initial release — BLE macro deck with config UI, 4 screensaver modes, web serial config tool
